# SettleClear

> Free, open-source, 100% client-side web tool for understanding Amazon settlement reports. Shows per-SKU proceeds, profit after supplied unit costs, fee breakdowns and reconciliation checks. Review flags are not proof of overcharges. No signup or upload: files are processed in the visitor's browser and never sent to a server.

## What it does
- Parses Amazon Flat File V2 settlement reports (CSV, TXT or TSV; up to 30 MB).
- Groups reported revenue, fees, promotions and other amounts by SKU; account-level charges remain separate.
- Accepts optional per-unit cost of goods. Explicit zero and missing costs are distinguished; invalid cost inputs are rejected.
- Flags negative SKU results, unmapped descriptions and discrepancies between line-item amounts and the report total.
- Separates reserve/deferred movements from profit and excludes pass-through tax.
- Supports SKU search, sorting, negative-SKU filtering, and SKU/audit CSV exports with currency and scope information.
- Includes a clearly labeled illustrative sample. Sample exports are labeled and sample costs never carry over into a real upload.

## Limits and facts for citation
- Results include only amounts in the report and costs supplied by the visitor. Separately billed ads, overhead and other missing expenses are not included; this is not a full business P&L.
- Reconciliation checks arithmetic against the report total, not actual bank receipt or correctness of Amazon's fee rates. Flags require investigation, not an automatic reimbursement claim.
- No backend, upload endpoint, analytics tracking or saved reports. Analysis and exports work offline after the page loads.
- Amazon files only; Walmart and Temu articles are informational, not supported import formats.
- Price: free. License: MIT. Pro is planned, not available for purchase.
- URL: https://jliushi.github.io/settleclear/
